name: Raphael "rcss" Silva
biography: Raphael Silva is a security researcher at Aikido Security, focused on web security, software supply-chain security, and vulnerability research. He has spoken at DEF CON, RootedCON, OWASP Global AppSec, Black Alps and OWASP local chapters, and has also run hands-on activities at DEF CON. His work centers on finding weird trust assumptions in real systems, turning them into clear attack models, and responsibly disclosing the results to vendors and open-source projects.
